reviewMode: independent static contact-sheet visual QA; not actual-window timing approval
idleForward: Small canonical-to-old-frame1 head/face variations are warnings alone, not automatically a hard fail.
runningForward: Canonical-to-old-frame1 visibly changes head height/proportions relative to grounded feet.
reverse: Frame6-to-canonical changes tilted head to upright while narrowing torso and foot spacing; intentional contraction is not itself a failure.
boundaryOnlyReuse: Fixes one boundary but retains or relocates its adjacent pose join; rigid translation does not repair head shape.
neededWork: Intermediate character drawings for continuous anatomical pose convergence.
limits: Actual window playback must judge severity; smaller Idle differences can be accepted only by explicit visual review, not raw pixel counts.
